desc: A self-hosted URL-shortening service built with Spring Boot and DynamoDB.
focus: Designed around predictable low-latency lookups, short-code generation, expiration handling, and deployment on self-managed infrastructure.

desc: An anonymous paste-sharing service built with Spring Boot and Cassandra.
focus: Designed to explore write-heavy workloads, distributed storage, expiration policies, and scalable content retrieval.

desc: A self-rescheduling adhan system that recalculates prayer times and rewrites its own crontab each day.
focus: Built around scheduling, automation, and reliability: each run installs the day's cron jobs and schedules its own next execution, running unattended on a home server.
